exposure: CTG plus ST interval analysis (STAN) of fetal ECG
finding: In high-risk pregnancies, the use of CTG plus ST interval analysis (STAN) of fetal ECG, compared to the use of CTG alone, reduced the cesarean section rate for fetal distress, although it was associated with a higher total rate of operative deliveries.
mod_finding: STAN monitoring was associated with a higher total operativity rate, both vaginal (11% versus 3.12%, p = 0.015) and cesarean (17% versus 4.37%, p = 0.001)
